mentions.sentence: RESULTS: Seizure onset was between 1 and 4 days of age with daily tonic asymmetric, focal and clonic seizures in nine patients and status epilepticus in the remaining six.

Twelve patients had moderate-to-severe developmental delay at follow-up.
